name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$tab39
description: Mozilla GeckoView, in the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service when it needs another process for web page content. GeckoView assigns these numbered Services from a pool so page work runs separately from the main app process.
disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.
